result.title: What Does an Agent Need? Bundle-Aware Agent Resource Composition
result.summary: An agent resource's value depends on its backbone and companion resources and is known only after execution. Token-based generators remain tied to their training catalog, while independent resource scoring misses complementarities and reused bundles target other tasks. We formulate Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition (AgentComposition): jointly selecting a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility. Our Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation retrieves candidate resources and past configurations of similar tasks. A fine-tuned generator reads resource descriptions and recombines candidates through constrained beam search, allowing new resources without retraining. A bundle-aware critic ranks complete configurations using a large language model (LLM) teacher and historically successful configurations as execution proxies, and adapts to execution feedback when available. We evaluate reference recovery, offline execution with judged and native rewards, and online recommendation with real execution, building AgentSelect-Exec with 5,060 executed configurations. Our method recovers the complete reference configuration within ten candidates for 67.73% of AgentSelect queries, nearly twice the strongest baseline, and leads all baselines on SkillsBench. The proxy-trained critic raises the top-ranked agent's execution score from 7.58 to 8.37 out of 10; execution feedback increases it to 8.78, above the strongest baselines. Four target-domain queries suffice to adapt the generator to SkillsBench. Agents recommended online outperform the strongest baselines under both an LLM judge and native verifiers. These results support learning and transferring joint resource composition from task experience.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition 问题，即联合选择 backbone 模型与工具技能包以最大化端到端执行效用；方法检索相似任务的候选资源与历史配置，用微调生成器加约束束搜索重组候选，并以 LLM 教师和历史成功配置作为执行代理训练 critic，在有真实执行反馈时继续适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用执行代理与历史成功配置替代真实执行来排序候选」以及少量目标域查询即可适配的做法，可能为 LVR 中缺少直接监督时的 latent 假设筛选与验证提供参照，但原文并不涉及视觉推理状态，联系需较多核查。
